hero_kpi_rationale: Cognex positions itself as a leader in AI integration for industrial vision, a key segment for future automation. Customer adoption of these technologies is a strong indicator of their digital transformation.

kpis.name: AI Vision Adoption
kpis.explanation: Indicates the proportion of customers adopting artificial intelligence-based vision solutions.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the penetration of AI technologies in Cognex's vision solutions, reflecting the transition toward smarter and autonomous systems in industry.
kpis.signal: AI is becoming a key driver for differentiation and efficiency in industrial vision.

kpis.name: Logistics Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of revenue generated by the logistics sector.
kpis.description: Represents Cognex's financial performance in the logistics sector, a key market for its barcode reading and vision solutions.
kpis.signal: The logistics sector is a major growth driver, benefiting from increased warehouse automation and e-commerce.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the direct profitability of Cognex's products and solutions before accounting for other operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Strong gross margin indicating high value-added and effective control of production costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating costs.
kpis.description: Measures the profitability of the company's core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Robust operating margin, signaling efficient expense management and solid profitability.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: This ratio indicates Cognex's commitment to innovation and development of new technologies to remain competitive.
kpis.signal: Sustained R&D investment, essential to maintain technological leadership in industrial vision and AI.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect resources allocated by the company to acquire or improve its physical and technological assets.
kpis.signal: Increasing Capex, potentially to support production growth or expansion of capacities.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of goods and services sold during the period.
kpis.description: Total revenue represents the company's overall performance in terms of sales.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth, indicating high demand for Cognex's solutions.

kpis.name: AI-Enabled Vision Solutions Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new vision solutions sold that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: This KPI measures market adoption of Cognex's AI capabilities, indicating a trend toward more advanced and autonomous vision solutions.
kpis.signal: AI is becoming a core component of Cognex's offerings, meeting growing demand for smarter vision systems.

kpis.name: Logistics Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of revenue generated by the logistics sector.
kpis.description: This KPI highlights Cognex's performance in the logistics sector, a rapidly expanding market for vision and barcode reading solutions.
kpis.signal: The logistics sector continues to be a key growth driver, supported by automation and e-commerce.

kpis.name: SLX Devices Adoption
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customers using SLX-series devices designed for the logistics sector.
kpis.description: Measures adoption of SLX devices, which combine AI with intuitive workflows to simplify industrial vision implementation in logistics.
kpis.signal: The SLX series, integrating AI, is gaining rapid traction in the logistics sector, facilitating adoption of advanced technologies.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years reported (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 0.994 Bn USD last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a rapidly evolving industrial vision market, with competing firms potentially developing similar or superior technologies, which could impact Cognex's market share.

risks.title: Technological Dependence and Adaptation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on technological innovation, particularly artificial intelligence, for its products and services, which could make it difficult to adapt to rapid technological changes.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks and Trade Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions and trade uncertainties are currently affecting Cognex's operations, particularly in the automotive sector with significant headwinds observed in 2025. These risks could extend to other regional markets.

risks.title: Dependence on Cyclical Industry Demand
risks.score_rationale: Cognex is heavily reliant on cyclical industries such as automotive and consumer electronics. Slowdowns in these sectors, as observed in 2025, could reduce demand for industrial vision solutions.

ai_positioning.summary: Cognex positions AI as a core element of its product strategy, particularly in industrial vision. The company integrates AI capabilities into its vision solutions and launched its SLX series in 2025, combining AI with intuitive workflows for the logistics sector. The company emphasizes enabling customer adoption of AI through accessible tools and products.
evidence: Launch of SLX series in 2025: Solutions Experience devices integrating AI with intuitive deployment workflows
SLX product description: combines AI with intuitive deployment workflows to simplify implementation
Mission positioning: making advanced machine vision easy by integrating cutting-edge AI with intuitive deployment workflows
Mention of AI-enabled vision technology in logistics, consumer electronics, and semiconductor solutions
AI-driven product portfolio designed for easy adoption and rapid deployment
